policy: Monotone release statement under the persistent release identity. This statement defines the CURRENT authorized state of the conformance suite. A verifier that has accepted this counter must refuse any lower counter (rollback) and any conflicting statement at the same counter (fork). The next release chains to this one via previous_release.sha256 and must anchor at a higher Rekor log index.
